evals.prompt: Create a project constitution focused on security and testing.
evals.expected_output: Discovery-driven rules with evidence, user approval before writing, validation offered
expectations: Checked for an existing CONSTITUTION.md at the project root before anything else
Launched discovery agents for the applicable perspectives simultaneously in a single response
Every proposed rule cites specific file:line evidence from the codebase
Classified each rule with a level (L1/L2/L3)
Presented discovered rules for user approval before writing CONSTITUTION.md
Did not generate generic rules without codebase evidence
Offered to run validation after writing

evals.prompt: Update our constitution — a CONSTITUTION.md already exists at the project root.
evals.expected_output: Existing rules parsed, new discoveries merged after approval
expectations: Read and parsed the existing CONSTITUTION.md rules
Routed to the update flow rather than creating from template
Merged approved rules into the existing file rather than overwriting it
Presented proposed changes for user approval before saving
